title: Conditional visible-history hazard error cannot universally be acquired by reset/product probes at polynomial horizon cost
parent_main_artifacts_policy: Frozen main theorem, verifier, receipts, results and manifest are unchanged. This contract is an independent extension record.

target.r: Q^{J_U}E(X_U,:), including negative current-label row entry
target.rbar: E[r | U, full visible history H_U, action, recorded controller randomness]
target.D_cond: E||rbar-vhat(U,H_U)||^2 under unprobed occupation law U uniform on [0,T]
target.purpose: Whole visible path TV <= min(1,T sqrt((k-1)D_cond)) plus initial visible-law error; perfect-predictor complete acquisition would improve the raw source certificate.

hard_family.hidden_size: 2N(m+2)+1; exponential size and arbitrary alternative description disclosed
hard_family.gain_library: g_(a,+)=2^(e_a(destination)-e_a(source)), g_(a,-)=inverse; products multiply on the same edge
hard_family.preparation_null: H=(I,b) uniform on M pair IDs times one bit; Z independent fair sign; start at depth 0
hard_family.preparation_alternative: P(Z=z | H=(i,b))=(1+alpha z (-1)^b xi_i)/2 for unknown fixed xi_i in {-1,+1}
hard_family.preparation_support: Every conditional sign mass >=1/4; all contexts uniform; visible initial label fixed; preparation repeats independently within a model
hard_family.same_generator: Preselected H,Z are fixed through an episode. Rate-one steps reveal H bits with depth parity/lastbit labels; one further rate-one step enters A; A exits to absorbing B at c+delta Z.
hard_family.null_predictor: Prefix hazards are fair-next-bit rates 1/2, last prefix step to A has rate 1; at A age s hazard is c-delta tanh(delta s); B has rate 0
hard_family.scope: Unknown repeatable initial preparation in a finite reducible episodic model. No stationary, irreducible, known-preparation or cheaply implementable arbitrary-xi claim.

proved_claims: Null visible predictor is exactly correct, including terminal waiting-time posterior: D_cond(null)=0.
Every fixed alternative has full visible path TV from the null >1/32 at T=4(m+1). The distinguishing event depends on the alternative sign map.
D_raw is identical under the null and every alternative for every horizon.
Every r-reset adaptive kinetic/probe transcript is a common stochastic channel of r independent full(H,Z) samples, even allowing arbitrary observation times, stopping, switching and postselection.
Averaging one fixed iid-uniform xi vector across the alternative models, transcript TV from null <=r(r-1)/(2M); all data laws coincide conditional on no pair-ID collision.
Two-sided 2/3-success conditional-risk estimation at error 1/(1024T), or 2/3-sound upper certification complete at null threshold 1/(512T), requires Omega(sqrt(M)) resets.
No one-reset integrable unbiased observable estimates D_cond uniformly on this family. An r-reset unbiased observable bounded in absolute value by B requires B>=M/[256T r(r-1)].
For fixed alpha, O(sqrt(M)) ordinary visible episodes suffice for the promised null-versus-alternative test using terminal outcome collision statistics; observation time O(T) per reset.

additional_interfaces.observable_dual_witnesses: Every frozen predictable critic f gives an observable lower bound L(f) on D_cond via visible jump compensators; finite libraries have explicit finite concentration cost. An upper certificate additionally needs a critic approximation/complexity promise.
additional_interfaces.independent_conditional_replicas: Two independent hidden draws from Law(X_U|H_U), with same observed history/time/action, make the cross-rate moment equal D_cond after predictor subtraction. Same-hidden-state clones instead return D_raw. Conditional preparation correctness and cost are additional resources.
additional_interfaces.finite_conditional_closure: A known finite observed context C, predictor C-measurable and supplied conditional-hazard projection error <=delta^2, reduces acquisition to tagged first moments and context masses. Rare-cell truncation bounds cost, but the context size and closure-error certificate are charged.

not_assumed: Context-selected reset or an oracle that changes the preparation to a chosen context
Independent posterior resampling after a visible history
Hidden sign cloning as a substitute for posterior resampling
Cheap implementation or preprocessing of arbitrary xi
General inability to acquire D_cond given enough resets
New lower-bound phenomenon in distribution testing or first-ever martingale duality

verification.exact_checks_scope: Finite mixture likelihoods and collision agreement, explicit hidden generator and product probe synthesis, exact rational terminal hazard and projection identities, collision-statistic first/second moments
verification.numerical_checks_scope: Marked high-precision diagnostics for occupation integrals and the fixed-alternative path gap; analytic inequalities are the proof

resumable_next_gate: Independent read of the complete finite reduction and a separately implemented conditional-risk acquisition benchmark. Any attempted polynomial extension must identify a supplied representation or posterior-resampling operation that excludes this family.
